column1: # SYNTHETIC DEMO CROSSWALK — all gene identities below are fabricated for AREE demo purposes.
# WARNING: the LOC numbers used here are NOT unused placeholders. Most of them collide
# with real NCBI GeneIDs for Magallana gigas that denote entirely different genes
# (e.g. LOC105333935 is labelled 'hsp70' here but is really ubiquitin carboxyl-terminal
# hydrolase 32; LOC105341000 is labelled 'actin' here but is really ADAMTS adt-1).
# For that reason this file MUST NOT be merged with a real crosswalk — a union would
# silently attach demo biology to real accessions.
# This file is the default only so that `make demo` and the test suite stay
# self-contained. To harmonize real studies, build a real crosswalk and select it:
